project.title: 16S genes of Bacteria & Archaea from anaerobic sludge digesting municipal and petroleum-containing wastes.
project.description: The overall objective of this study was to analyze 16S rRNA genes in the DNA extracted from anaerobic sludge from methanogenic bioreactor digesting municipal and petroleum-containing wastes to better understand the biogas-producing microbial community.
project.center_name: Research Center of Biotechnology, Winogradsky Institute of Microbiology, Russian Academy of Sciences
